import unittest

from solution import append_enrollment


class AppendEnrollmentTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_appends_formatted_entry_and_returns_same_list(self):
        records = ["existing"]
        result = append_enrollment(records, 7, "  Ada Lovelace  ", 36, "  member ")
        self.assertIs(result, records)
        self.assertEqual(records, ["existing", "0007|Ada Lovelace|36|member"])

    def test_sequence_padding_age_boundaries_and_large_sequence(self):
        records = []
        append_enrollment(records, 1, "A", 0, "X")
        append_enrollment(records, 10000, "B", 130, "Y")
        self.assertEqual(records, ["0001|A|0|X", "10000|B|130|Y"])

    def test_records_must_be_list_of_strings(self):
        for bad in (None, (), "", {"x"}):
            with self.subTest(bad=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_enrollment(bad, 1, "A", 1, "C")
        records = ["ok", 3]
        before = records.copy()
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            append_enrollment(records, 1, "A", 1, "C")
        self.assertEqual(records, before)

    def test_wrong_field_types_leave_records_unchanged(self):
        cases = [
            (True, "A", 1, "C"),
            (1.0, "A", 1, "C"),
            (1, None, 1, "C"),
            (1, "A", False, "C"),
            (1, "A", 2.5, "C"),
            (1, "A", 1, []),
        ]
        for sequence, name, age, category in cases:
            records = ["stable"]
            with self.subTest(case=(sequence, name, age, category)):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    append_enrollment(records, sequence, name, age, category)
                self.assertEqual(records, ["stable"])

    def test_invalid_values_leave_records_unchanged(self):
        cases = [
            (0, "A", 1, "C"),
            (-1, "A", 1, "C"),
            (1, "A", -1, "C"),
            (1, "A", 131, "C"),
            (1, "   ", 1, "C"),
            (1, "A", 1, "\t"),
            (1, "A|B", 1, "C"),
            (1, "A\nB", 1, "C"),
            (1, "A", 1, "C\rD"),
            (1, "A", 1, "C|D"),
        ]
        for sequence, name, age, category in cases:
            records = ["stable"]
            with self.subTest(case=(sequence, name, age, category)):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    append_enrollment(records, sequence, name, age, category)
                self.assertEqual(records, ["stable"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
